summary: EDA controller TLS files under `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/eda/`: `server.key` (web service key), `cache.cert`/`cache.key` (mTLS to its Redis cache) and `websocket.cert`/`websocket.key` (WebSocket endpoint). The installer's internal CA certificate is `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/ca/ansible-automation-platform-managed-ca-cert.crt`.
questions: Where is the EDA WebSocket certificate?
Where is the AAP installer-managed CA certificate?
Which certificate does EDA use for Redis mTLS?
